description: Adds an HTTPS address CodeGene sends the chosen events to, signed under the Standard Webhooks spec (the webhook-id, webhook-timestamp and webhook-signature headers). The answer carries the endpoint's signing secret (whsec_...) exactly once: give it to the person to paste into the receiver at once, because it is never shown again. The address must be https:// and a public domain name. Send a test with send_webhook_test right after. Only owners and admins can add one.

events.description: The events to send to it.

reason.description: Why, in a sentence: kept in the workspace's activity.

url.description: The receiver's https:// address, for example a Zapier or Make hook.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from whoami; omit when there is one.

name: add_webhook
title: Add a webhook
